articles.title: SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin
articles.summary: This SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin for May 2025 highlights "Galaxy Season," a period best for observing numerous galaxies, with the Sombrero Galaxy (M104) as the featured target. The bulletin also announces upcoming SJAA events, including a Pinnacles Star Party and a Telescope Workshop. Additionally, it details various volunteer opportunities within the club, such as for the Imaging SIG, Loaner Program, and School Star Party Program, and encourages members to complete a feedback survey.
